prompt:
Design a polished high fidelity UI design presentation for Astro Flow Jam mobile space puzzle game's SHOP. Use attached screenshot as style reference: navy background, cyan outlined rounded blue panels, glossy colorful cartoon icons, white rounded bold typography, gold Saturn-shaped coin currency, green purchase buttons, astronaut avatar, lives HUD, bottom shop/rocket/gallery navigation. Improve visual hierarchy, reduce neon bloom and star clutter. This is a design mockup, not code. Create a wide high resolution presentation with THREE tall mobile screen layouts side by side, no phone hardware, crisp legible text, equal widths, plus a small separate fail offer popup inset beneath/right if space. Labels above screens: 01 PACKS, 02 COINS, 03 SPECIAL. The screens show different scroll positions/categories in the same consistent shop. Header consistent: astronaut avatar, heart 5 Full, gold Saturn coin 580, settings. Title Shop and segmented tabs Packs / Coins / Special. Bottom navigation fixed with Shop selected.
SCREEN 1 PACKS: vertically scrolling content represented as six compact wide cards in a tall screen, entire cards visible. Each has title left, colorful space cargo crate illustration, coin amount, four distinct booster mini icons (purple rocket +1, orange cyan portal, blue freeze stopwatch, green UFO) each with count, heart infinity with duration, green price button right. Exact products:
Starter Bundle $4.99 — 1,000 coins, each booster x1, infinite lives 1h. Small badge ONE TIME.
Small Bundle $9.99 — 5,000 coins, each booster x1, infinite lives 2h.
Medium Bundle $19.99 — 10,000 coins, each booster x2, infinite lives 2h. POPULAR ribbon.
Large Bundle $34.99 — 25,000 coins, each booster x5, infinite lives 6h.
Mega Bundle $79.99 — 50,000 coins, each booster x14, infinite lives 18h.
Ultra Bundle $99.99 — 65,000 coins, each booster x24, infinite lives 24h. BEST VALUE ribbon.
Give starter warm violet accent, medium cyan accent, ultra restrained gold accent; keep readable and coherent, no excessive decoration.
SCREEN 2 COINS: refill lives slim wide card at top, heart icon, Refill Lives, All 5 lives, green coin purchase button 900. Then 2-column 3-row grid of coin packages. Gold Saturn coin graphics evolve from a few coins to small pouch, pile, cargo box, treasure chest, large overflowing chest. Exact labels and prices: 1,000 $1.99; 5,000 $7.99; 10,000 $14.99 POPULAR; 25,000 $29.99; 50,000 $54.99 BEST VALUE; 100,000 $99.99. No extra fake discounts.
SCREEN 3 SPECIAL: two spacious premium offer cards: No Ads $7.99 with crossed-out ad screen icon, caption Remove ads. No Ads Bundle $11.99 with same ad icon, gold Saturn coins 1,000, four booster icons each x1, infinity heart 1h. Below, a visibly SEPARATE framed popup concept labeled POST-LOSS OFFER (not a permanent shop product): title One more chance, 2,700 coins, four booster icons each x1, green button $5.99, clear X close in upper corner. Do not imply these offers are already implemented. Footer Restore Purchases on special shop.
Every price matches exactly. No event icons, no timers for artificial scarcity, no sale strike-throughs. Friendly premium casual mobile game look, clean rounded cards and enough padding. Prioritize readability of product contents. Background subdued navy space with sparse tiny stars. Present full artwork directly.
